title: Company OKR Funnel and Initiative Gatekeeper Playbook
creator: Maya Gonzales
description:
Goal: Create a repeatable, lightweight playbook that funnels company-level OKR ambitions into a small set of vetted initiatives and a single initiative-router that maps owners, critical dependencies, and rollback gates. This ticket captures the MVP playbook, acceptance criteria, decision rules, and the initial set of wiring templates (meeting cadence, RACI, and a minimal artifact checklist) to be trialed in the Q2 planning window.

Why: Current company-level objective signals are noisy and produce an overly broad list of proposed initiatives each quarter. That inflates cross-team coordination cost and leads to scope creep. We need a reproducible funnel + gatekeeper pattern to protect engineering capacity, improve predictability, and make OKR outcomes measurable.

Scope:
- Define the funnel stages (Signal -> Proposal -> Scoped Initiative -> Approved Initiative -> Committed Roadmap Item) and explicit entry/exit criteria for each stage.
- Build the Initiative Router spreadsheet + lightweight templates (one-pager, dependency map, rollout risk matrix).
- Define decision rights (who approves, who vets technical feasibility, who owns rollback).
- Create a 6-week pilot run with Finance, Eng Infra, Runtime, Product, and Design to route and gate 6 candidate initiatives.
- Document the playbook in Confluence and produce a follow-up retrospective with quantitative metrics (lead time from signal to commitment, # of blocked initiatives, variance vs. capacity plan).

Out of scope: tactical PR triaging, team-level sprint planning details, long-form product spec construction beyond the one-pager template.
acceptance_criteria: Funnel definition published in Confluence with clear entry/exit criteria and examples
Initiative Router template created and populated with first 6 pilot initiatives
Decision RACI documented with names/roles and escalation path
Pilot run completed and retrospective recorded with at least three measurable improvements (e.g., reduced candidate churn, improved commit predictability)
Templates stored in Drive and linked from Confluence with edit permissions for PM leads
decisions: Use a 3-stage radar for technical risk (Low/Medium/High) — High risk initiatives require Eng Architecture sign-off
Adopt the proposed funnel stages as the canonical company funnel for Q2 trial
Limit initial pilot to 6 initiatives to keep cross-team coordination tractable
Financial gating: any initiative requiring >$150k incremental spend needs Finance pre-approval

Schedule pilot kickoff with stakeholders (Product, Eng Runtime, Infra, Finance, Design) — target 2026-03-18
Create Initiative Router doc and invite nominated initiative owners to populate by 2026-03-22
Run first gating workshop and record decisions in Router — target 2026-03-29
Collect metrics during pilot and prepare retrospective deck for 2026-04-12 review
